title.zh: 两千年 · 世界人口成片配乐

prompt:
Instrumental only, no vocals, no voice, no lyrics. Total length: exactly 2 minutes 50 seconds.
Epic dark phonk meets cinematic orchestral trailer music, scoring a short film on 2,000 years of human population: empires rise and fall, plagues, wars, then the modern explosion of humanity.
Tempo: strict, steady 130 BPM in 4/4 from the first second to the last, D minor. Every beat clear and on the grid (the film is cut to the beat). No tempo changes, no rubato, no fade-ins.
Sound: drift-phonk cowbell lead melody, heavily distorted 808 bass, hard trap drums with crisp hi-hats, Memphis-style percussion, layered with epic orchestral strings, brass stabs, low choir and taiko.

Follow this timeline exactly:
[0:00 - 0:06] Intense opening, full volume from the first beat: a massive orchestral + 808 hit on every beat, cowbell riff above.
[0:06 - 0:09] Rewind: reverse cymbal, tape-stop / vinyl rewind sweep, rising chirps, then one beat of silence.
[0:09] THE DROP, full power.
[0:09 - 0:42] Full drift phonk groove, cowbell lead melody, distorted 808, aggressive.
[0:42 - 1:23] Same groove, bigger and darker: low choir, brass, taiko; big impacts at 0:42, 1:02 and 1:14.
[1:23 - 1:49] New theme: urgent string ostinato over the phonk beat, building.
[1:49 - 2:11] Solemn and clearly quieter: drums drop out or play sparse half-time, no cowbell, low strings, cello, distant choir, a slow tolling low bell. Respectful.
[2:11] Everything slams back in.
[2:11 - 2:32] The biggest, brightest section: full phonk drums, cowbell melody with the whole orchestra, uplifting and epic.
[2:32 - 2:44] Breakdown: drums stop, reflective piano and soft strings.
[2:44 - 2:50] One final huge cinematic hit, ringing out to silence.

description.en: The score of the short film 2,000 Years of World Population: take W7 of Rise and Fall, re-cut on bar lines to 2:51 (cold open, rewind, five acts, ending). Epic dark phonk meets cinematic orchestral trailer: drift-phonk cowbell lead, distorted 808 bass, hard trap drums, strings, brass stabs, low wordless choir and taiko. Steady 130 BPM grid, D minor, made for beat-cut edits.
description.zh: 《两千年世界人口》成片配乐：「兴衰 · W7」按小节重新剪辑到 2:51（开场、倒回、五幕、结尾）。史诗暗黑 Phonk 加电影预告片管弦：漂移 Phonk 牛铃主旋律、失真 808 贝斯、硬核 Trap 鼓，叠弦乐、铜管重音、低沉无词合唱和太鼓。全曲稳定 130 BPM，D 小调，适合卡点剪辑。
